request: bounded first-equals-last, bounded interval, open-ended, suffix
required_observation: each typed non-whole form is signed exactly and no multi-range form exists

request: first below, equal to, and above last
required_observation: reject only the inverted interval before HTTP admission and preserve destination ownership

request: one, total-sized, larger-than-total, zero
required_observation: zero is rejected; positive suffixes resolve against the same returned total

request: Whole_Object
required_observation: whole reads use Get_Whole and cannot silently select range semantics

request: exact quoted opaque ETag, empty, weak, unquoted, list
required_observation: require one exact strong validator and preserve destination ownership on rejection

request: absent, opaque, reserved URI bytes
required_observation: preserve the optional provider version exactly alongside If-Match

request: absent and exact expected bucket owner
required_observation: sign only the modeled singleton and retain no borrowed caller text

request: absent and requester
required_observation: preserve the established GetObject payer policy without a new default

request: false and true
required_observation: request checksum mode exactly without changing range or generation binding

request: zero, exact, one-short, and larger destination
required_observation: caller pool capacity is the only retained-body bound and exact required length is reported

request: future, already expired, expires while active
required_observation: one absolute deadline covers signing, exchange, drain, and Finish without restart

request: pre-requested, during connect, during body
required_observation: cancel, drain, restore destination, and leave no hidden child or transport owner

request: same owners and changed HTTP, destination, or token
required_observation: allow consumed same-owner restart and reject every retained-owner change

request: 206, unsolicited 200, other 2xx
required_observation: only 206 can produce bytes and a resolved interval

request: exact requested, absent, empty, malformed, weak, different
required_observation: require the exact strong generation validator before exposing bytes

request: equal and unequal physical ETag fields
required_observation: reject physical singleton duplication without first-value or last-value selection

request: absent, zero, exact, short, long, duplicate
required_observation: require one canonical length equal to retained bytes

request: absent, valid, empty, malformed, duplicate
required_observation: require one physical valid Content-Range before exposing bytes

request: requested interval, shifted, shortened, extended
required_observation: bind the returned first and last exactly to typed resolution

request: exact positive total, zero, below last, numeric overflow
required_observation: validate total and return it from the same immutable response snapshot

request: first byte, middle, final byte, full representation
required_observation: accept every exactly bound satisfiable interval including a one-byte result

request: start below final, at final, beyond total
required_observation: resolve to the returned final byte or reject an unsatisfiable/mismatched response

request: count below, equal to, and above total
required_observation: resolve to the exact final suffix or whole representation without a prior HEAD

request: first greater than last
required_observation: reject malformed Content-Range and clear all retained bytes

request: bytes */total and HTTP 416
required_observation: return a typed service rejection with no resolved interval and an empty destination

request: multipart/byteranges with one or several parts
required_observation: reject multipart range bodies because the API models one exact interval

request: fixed length, fragmented head/body, chunked body
required_observation: produce identical bytes and metadata across legal HTTP framing

request: 404 NoSuchKey and 412 PreconditionFailed
required_observation: return the parsed rejection, no resolved interval, and an empty destination

request: bodyless, valid bounded XML, malformed XML, oversized XML
required_observation: never expose error bytes as object bytes and fail boundedly when semantics are incomplete

request: version, checksum, payer, user metadata, encryption fields
required_observation: validate and return modeled fields from the same response as bytes and interval

request: fragmented success, rejection, overflow, malformed singleton
required_observation: finish exactly once and restore all buffer, slot, and transport ownership

request: fragmented success, rejection, overflow, malformed singleton
required_observation: match native outcomes without a helper task or simulated asynchronous call

request: success then rejection then malformed response on one configured client
required_observation: no stale body, range, generation, completion, or source state crosses operations

request: active parent finalized before Finish
required_observation: no detached child, destination token, cancellation pointer, or completion slot survives finalization
